tonight.headline: 0–4 in all but name: McMillan scored 45
body: Bad news first. You trail 97.6 to 153.6 with only Alvin Kamara left, and ESPN gives you 1%. Tetairoa McMillan caught 14 passes for 192 yards and two touchdowns on Sunday night, 45.2 points, in the game your Jalen Coker missed. Add Kyren Williams' 36.7 and Aye-Aye had the week's best score before your bench came into it.

Your bench did come into it: Monangai 28.0 and Gordon 18.0 sat behind Tuten's 11.1. That is 34.9 points before Kamara plays, and it wouldn't have been enough. Nothing can be changed tonight. Tuesday's brief is the one that matters: the last before claims process, and it needs Monangai's thumb result first.

case.label: Their side
case.body: McMillan 45.2, Kyren Williams 36.7 in the flex, McCaffrey 16.0, St. Brown 15.5. They are finished at 153.56 and left Aaron Jones' 16.8 on the bench.

case.label: Your side
case.body: Allen 18.5, Fairbairn 16, Warren 15.6, Likely 13.6, Tuten 11.1, Addison 9.1, the Vikings 8, Wilson 5.7. Three receivers inactive. No starter was hurt.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing. Kamara would need 56 points.

whatWentWrong.title: The thumb decides Tuesday's claim, and there is no result yet
whatWentWrong.lead: Monangai ran 30 times for 28.0 on your bench. He was last week's planned drop; now he is the unknown the claim waits on.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: 30 carries, 146 yards, two touchdowns (archive), after ten carries in each of three games. Swift lost a fumble and didn't play again; his coach said 'No, nothing like that' when asked if he was benched. The thumb was being examined on Monday (NBC Sports/PFT; Bears Wire).

case.label: What it changes
case.body: There is no Do-first card today because there is no drop to name. If the thumb costs weeks, his seat opens and Metcalf is the claim. If it doesn't, he is a flex candidate and the claim needs a different seat, which this roster doesn't have.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A diagnosis. Tuesday's brief acts on it either way.

whatWentWrong.sources: Week 1–4 archive · NBC Sports/PFT · Bears Wire · Heavy · Yahoo

whatWentWrong.title: Jefferson's return got less certain overnight
whatWentWrong.lead: Sunday it was 'hopeful for Week 5'. Monday his coach won't project it, and the bye is Week 6.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: O'Connell: 'I don't have any real projection on whether we'll have him or not' (Yahoo; Yardbarker, 5 Oct). McLaurin 'pushed to play' in London and may return. Coker was inactive and Carolina are off. Addison drew 6 targets while Hockenson caught 13.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: Week 5's receivers are Wilson and Addison, with a back in the flex. That is a lineup, so a third receiver is depth and not a need. It is why the claim is worth making only if a seat opens for free.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jefferson ruled out through the bye on Tuesday: then a receiver is worth more than Coker's two idle weeks, and Tuesday's brief should say so.

whatWentWrong.sources: Yahoo · Yardbarker · RotoWire · CBS Sports · Week 4 archive

lineupCheck.verdict: The lineup as set is the projection lineup. Kamara in the flex is the only starter left to play and no bench player can replace him.

worthALook.name: DK Metcalf
worthALook.lead: Still the receiver to claim, if a seat opens. This morning there isn't one.

case.label: The role
case.body: 5 catches on 9 targets for 115 on Thursday, 16.5 (archive); 10, 9, 5, 9 targets in four games. No injury news. No Week 5 waiver column lists him, because almost nowhere is he available; here he is.

case.label: The number that kills it today
case.body: Every bench seat is either an injured receiver with a bigger role waiting (Jefferson, McLaurin, Coker) or a back who just scored 18 or 28. Wilson, Warren, Kamara, Gordon and Addison each have an injured teammate and can't be named as the drop.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Tuesday's brief, before claims process on Wed 7 Oct at 01:00 Mexico City. Three things decide it: Monangai's thumb result, any word on Jefferson, and tonight's Kamara game. If none of them opens a seat, there is no claim.

worthALook.name: Rico Dowdle
worthALook.lead: On waivers until Wednesday; the man who takes carries from your Warren when he returns.

case.label: The role

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: A handcuff to a back you start, on a roster with no free seat and five backs already.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A full Wednesday practice. By then claims have processed, so it would be a free-agent add if he clears, not a claim.
